not_storage: request.body.vote of POST /api/v3/votes is a WIRE value (agree = -1, frozen by ruling R-wire), not a stored one; it is compared as recorded.
basis: The 1,265-case characterization baseline was recorded against a database at agree = -1. Its only stored vote values are the database effect rows of cases 0528-0531 (POST /api/v3/votes). compare.cjs reads each one through this declaration, and the live rows through the replay database's own convention, and compares their meaning; the recorded bytes are not rewritten (P-078 1d).
